# Delos Recruitment

> Delos Recruitment Ltd is a specialist Rec2Rec (recruitment to recruitment) consultancy based in Surrey, England. We recruit for every role that makes a recruitment business work: trainees, recruiters, sales, marketing, operations and administration. We work primarily across the South East and cover the whole UK.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Delos Recruitment Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 16163283
- Founded: April 2025 by Maria Gripari, Founder and Director
- Based in: Surrey, England
- Coverage: primarily the South East of England, and the whole UK
- Specialism: Rec2Rec, hiring for recruitment businesses
- Roles we recruit for: trainee recruitment consultants, recruiters, sales, marketing, operations and administration
- Clients: recruitment businesses, from startups to SMEs
- Candidates: experienced recruiters looking for their next move, and people new to recruitment (trainee roles need no recruitment experience)
- Candidates are never charged
- Every conversation is confidential
- Contact: hello@delosrecruitment.co.uk, 07537 142 925 (also on WhatsApp), or book a call at https://calendly.com/maria-delosrecruitment

## How we work with recruitment businesses

1. A first call: we get to know your business, the role and the kind of person who will thrive in it.
2. The search: we get to know every candidate properly, beyond the CV, and only put forward people we believe will fit your team.
3. Interview preparation: we take the time to prepare every candidate and keep you updated throughout.
4. Building the team: we advise you on how to attract the right people and how to keep them.
5. Placement and beyond: we stay in touch with you and your new hire, and we are always there as a point of contact.

## Common myths about recruitment, and the truth

- Myth: a recruiter just fills the vacancy. Truth: we learn your business, not just the vacancy, and what the role will mean for it now and later. We place people so the business and the person both grow.
- Myth: your CV says it all. Truth: you are more than two pages of experience, and what you want is more than a job description. We take the time to understand both.
- Myth: once the CV is sent, the recruiter disappears. Truth: we prepare every candidate for every interview, keep clients updated throughout, and stay in touch with both long after the start date.
- Myth: you need experience to become a recruiter. Truth: you don't. If you have the motivation and the skills to succeed, our trainee roles are made for you.
- Myth: recruitment is just a stop gap. Truth: for plenty of people it becomes a long career. Whether it does depends on how you start, so we make sure you know what the job really involves before you say yes.
